title: NORMSAGE: Multi-Lingual Multi-Cultural Norm Discovery from Conversations On-the-Fly
benchmark_measurement: The ability to generate culturally-specific social norms from conversations, including a specific comparison of norms in 'Western vs Muslim' cultural contexts.
findings: The NORMSAGE+ framework successfully generated culturally-specific norms that were highly identifiable by humans. For the 'Western vs Muslim' comparison, human annotators could correctly identify which norm belonged to which culture with 91% accuracy, indicating the model's ability to capture and articulate norms associated with this religious group.
